name: Dimitri Volkov
bio:
Dimitri's journey into motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with Lada engines in his father's garage. After graduating from the Bauman Moscow State Technical University with a degree in engineering, he spent several years in the Russian automotive industry before seizing an opportunity to work with a small touring car team. His meticulous attention to detail and knack for optimizing processes quickly propelled him through the ranks. 

He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their best. He prioritizes clear communication, data-driven decision-making, and a relentless pursuit of marginal gains. Dimitri's calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to distill complex problems into actionable solutions set him apart, making him an invaluable asset to any racing team. He came to Stewart-Haas Racing looking to apply his experience to a larger, more complex organization.

physical.description: Dimitri is a powerfully built man with a serious, yet approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn-out notebook filled with handwritten notes.
Insists on having a daily cup of black tea, brewed using a specific Russian brand.
Meticulously cleans his desk every evening before leaving.
